args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The bank statement parser or schema validation appears to reject amounts containing currency symbols and grouping characters (e.g. ₹ or CHF with apostrophes). We propose updating the amount parsing logic to strip currency symbols and thousand separators like apostrophes or commas before parsing the amount value into a number. Please note that this finding is currently a candidate and not certain, as we could not finish searching the ingestion schema files for how amounts are validated and parsed.
